text:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "ref": "R2",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the app allows making multiple profiles for kids.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "This game is so fun and entertaining I recommend getting it for your kids and also you can make a bunch of profiles with your kids"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R3",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the app asks for a subscription and mentions price concerns.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "in the USA it cost 50.99$ for the subscription and in the UK it cost 30.50$ they might reduce the price to be honest because it is to pricey for that amount ;-; but overall khan is actaully a good game for kids/toddlers! I Recommend this game for toddlers/kids over the age of 7/5+"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R3",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the app collects subscription data and may share it, but the parent did not buy it.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "it asked for a subscription like usual kids games like sago mini piknik family of Toca Boca haha, but yes like usual kids games always asking for subscription so like.. I didn’t buy it firstly, especially for like people who don’t wanna buy the subscriptions."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R4",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the app is interactive, fun, and educational.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Khan Academy kids is interactive, fun and educational my child is enjoying learning and so it’s worth every penny!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R6",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the app's age gating does not work in practice, as it only goes up to 2nd grade despite being labeled 8+.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "it only goes up to 2nd grade and this is a bit childish for a 7 year old because it was giving like easy things"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R22",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the app's age range is too small, only going up to 2nd grade, which is insufficient for older children.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "So the game is really fun but the age range is to small I like it and I’m 11 so the highest it goes is 2nd grade even though older kids like it too."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R23",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports that their 3-year-old loves the app and it helps with counting and letters.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Such a wonderful resource, I rarely write reviews but I think this app and company deserves it. It’s the first thing my daughter asks to play after school every day. Really helps with counting and letters at her age."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R27",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the app is unsuitable for a 5th grader because it only goes up to 2nd grade.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "My kid is a fifth grader and it only went to second grade will be pressed 8+ and it didn’t even go up the grade It only stayed at second grade and down."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R31",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the app has insufficient parent control to remove or disable certain content.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Parents should be able to remove or disable certain videos and other contents for kits to see."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R42",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A user reports that grade 3 was removed after updates, causing dissatisfaction.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "So last time I was playing this game when I was little there was pre to third grade and after updates grade 3 is like gone where did it go like pls bring it back even tho I’m in 5th grade and my brother will love this and pls and higher grades like up to pre to grade 5 that is all I ask for."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R43",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the app lacks a timer feature to block non-learning content and control screen time.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "It needs a timer feature to block out non learning content. I was getting so frustrated using this with my daughter because instead of sticking to the learning paths she’d go to the bug area, or the change clothes features."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R25",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the app includes yoga routines with spiritual intentions that conflict with their Catholic beliefs.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Yoga carries specific spiritual intentions that conflict entirely with our Catholic beliefs, and I do not want this introduced to my daughter."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R17",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports that disturbing imagery appeared while the child was using the app.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "A grid of scary devil faces and men tied up with their mouth taped shut popped up for about 15 seconds while my kid was working on math. Very disturbing and disappointing since this is such a widely advertised app for homeschooling"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R45",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A user reports that the app is inoperable and freezes on the setup page.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "The app is inoperable. It has been reinstalled and freezes on the set up page."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R47",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A user reports that the app fails to create or manage profiles, requiring multiple installations.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Your app does nothing but perpetually load whether trying to get into a fresh profile to start, to click parent options, or even attempt to create a new profile from scratch in case there was an issue with the other profile. I’ve installed it three times. I’ve created 4 separate accounts trying to get her set up to use it."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R53",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A user requests adding a level for younger kids, indicating current levels may not suit younger ages.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Make a level for younger kidoes"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R54",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A user reports being 10 years old but the app only allows up to 2nd grade, causing frustration.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I am  10 years old and the app literally lets you choose your grade from pre-k to 2nd grade. Where is 5th grade?! You need to change this “age thing” immediately or I will delete the app."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R56",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A user reports the age range is too small, only going up to 2nd grade, and wants it extended to middle school.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "So the game is really fun but the age range is to small I like it and I’m 11 so the highest it goes is 2nd grade even though older kids like it too. Just try to put the age range a little higher like maybe up to middle school, thats all I’m asking."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R63",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "A reviewer mentions they have used many paid educational apps before, implying competition, but no regulatory issues are cited.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "believe me I’ve downloaded and paid for many previously."
    }
  ]
}
